name: Coffee Roaster (Wholesale)
tagline: A working trade storefront for a wholesale coffee roaster.
description: A complete, working wholesale shop for a trade coffee roaster: beans by the 1kg and 5kg bag, filter and capsule programs, syrups, disposables, a commercial grinder, a trade sampler and a weekly standing order — with categories, collections, a buyer-framed PDP (trade pricing, standing orders, net-30) and a merchandised home page. Industrial roastery theme — cool graphite ground, deep espresso, burnt copper. Shipped as Foundry Coffee Trade.
